# Application guidance

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the application root before making
changes, together with applicable directory instructions. It defines application
ownership, installed framework contracts, security boundaries and local checks.

Keep product changes in application-owned files. Do not patch vendor or bundled
framework code. Preserve unrelated work and report verification accurately.
Maintain detailed project rules in AGENTS.md, not in this bridge.
